name: Shibata (Niigata, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shibata city emblem in maroon: a stepped lozenge, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shibata, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 9 July 1934.

features.role: Shibata city emblem — a stepped lozenge, like a stylised character
